# Vortex

> A task orchestration engine for complex, multi-step agentic workflows: DAG scheduling, multi-provider model routing, experience-driven self-correction, and MCP tools (stdio + raw SSE).

Vortex is a headless MCP server and Go library. It schedules DAG task graphs,
routes work across model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, DeepSeek),
persists experience for failure-mode correction, and exposes 12 orchestration
tools for MCP-compatible clients (Claude Desktop, IDEs, custom agents).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, quick start, MCP client setup.

- [.env.example](.env.example): all supported environment variables.

## Build and test

```bash
go build ./...
go test ./...
```

Requires Go 1.26+. Copy `config.example.json` to `config.json` and reference API
keys via `api_key_env` (never inline). Run as `./vortex` for stdio (default) or
`VORTEX_TRANSPORT=sse ./vortex` for the raw SSE transport on :8000.

## Repository layout

- `core/` — engine: scheduler, DAG execution, reflection, spawner, tool router, verifiers
- `providers/` — model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, DeepSeek)
- `config/` — registry, loader, settings types
- `store/` — SQLite persistence, experience graph, memory bank
- `schemas/` — shared task/DAG types
- `tools/` — the 12 `orchestrator_*` MCP tool registrations
- `pkg/interfaces/` — the extension seam (implement these to embed Vortex)
- `skills/` — example skills (code review, test generation)
